THEME REVEAL: 22nd September

Something's Coming... A Prompt Competition Unlike Any Other

Get ready for a competition that flips the script on what "prompting" means.

You've written prompts to get answers, images, essays, code... but this time, we're taking it a step further. This competition will challenge you to go beyond just writing a prompt — you'll be creating something entirely new with it. Think less "chatbot conversation" and more "building your own working application" — powered entirely by prompts.

The theme is still under wraps — but here's a hint: it involves AI, creativity, logic, and a whole lot of imagination.

Why you should be excited:

  • A completely new kind of prompt-based challenge — not your typical "write a prompt" competition
  • Build a working app/software using nothing but the power of prompts
  • A chance to explore AI tools in a hands-on, creative way
  • Build something real, something you can showcase
  • No prior technical expertise needed — just curiosity and creativity

Who can participate?
Open to all students and enthusiasts who want to explore the intersection of AI and creativity.

Team Size: 1–4 members per team

What to expect:

  • The theme will be revealed on 22nd September
  • You'll use prompts to build and shape your creation
  • Submission opens after the theme reveal, along with rules and guidelines

Rewards:

  • E-certificates for all participants
  • Exciting prizes — to be announced soon!

Don't miss it: Theme drops 22nd September

Here's the reveal description:

THE THEME IS HERE!

Challenge: Build a Game — Any Concept, Any Type

The wait is over. Here's what you'll be creating:

Your Task:
Design and build a game — any concept, any genre, any style you can imagine. The only requirement: it has to be innovative. Use AI prompting to bring your idea to life from concept to final build.

Judging Criteria:
Your submission will be evaluated on:

  • Innovation — how original and fresh is your concept?
  • Game Creativity — how imaginative is the gameplay/design?
  • Approach — how well thought-out is your process?
  • Prompting — how effectively did you use prompts to build your game?
  • Engaging Uniqueness — does it stand out and hold attention?

Submission Requirements:
Live Deployed Link and,
You need to submit a single PDF with two things:

  • Page 1: A write-up explaining the concept of your game
  • From the next Page: The exact prompts you used to create your game

Team Size: 1–4 members

Time to bring your wildest game ideas to life — powered entirely by prompts. Let's see what you build.
